segments.speaker: Harpreet Gill
segments.text: Sat sri akal ji. Aaj routes aur transport cost pe baat karni hai, December peak hai.

segments.speaker: Mohit Saxena
segments.text: Haan paaji, November mein diesel ka kharcha phir badha hai, per trip lagbhag aath sau zyada.

segments.speaker: Anjali Verma
segments.text: Jaipur route pe sabse zyada problem hai. Do chhote trucks jaate hain aur dono aadhe khaali.

segments.speaker: Harpreet Gill
segments.text: Aadhe khaali kyun? Load toh pichhle mahine se badha hai.

segments.speaker: Anjali Verma
segments.text: Load badha hai par do jagah se pickup hota hai, timing match nahi karti, isliye alag alag nikalte hain.

segments.speaker: Mohit Saxena
segments.text: Agar pickup ek hi time pe kar dein toh ek bada truck kaafi hai, chaudah foot wala.

segments.speaker: Harpreet Gill
segments.text: Ek bada truck mein kharcha kitna bachega?

segments.speaker: Mohit Saxena
segments.text: Mahine ka lagbhag sattar hazaar, driver bhi ek hi lagega. Anjali, pickup ka time tum ek kar sakti ho?

segments.speaker: Anjali Verma
segments.text: Haan, pickup ka time main dono vendors se baat karke ek kar dungi, subah das baje.

segments.speaker: Harpreet Gill
segments.text: Theek hai, final karte hain, Jaipur route pe do chhote trucks ki jagah ek bada truck chalega.

segments.speaker: Mohit Saxena
segments.text: Done, agle hafte se shuru kar dete hain.

segments.speaker: Anjali Verma
segments.text: Ludhiana route pe raat ki delivery ka kya karein? Drivers shikayat kar rahe hain, fog bahut hai.

segments.speaker: Mohit Saxena
segments.text: Pichhle saal do accident hote hote bache the isi mahine.

segments.speaker: Harpreet Gill
segments.text: Safety pehle. Ludhiana pe raat ki delivery band, sirf din mein chalegi jab tak fog hai.

segments.speaker: Anjali Verma
segments.text: Customers ko batana padega ki delivery ek din late hogi.

segments.speaker: Harpreet Gill
segments.text: Haan, woh theek hai, accident se toh better hai.

segments.speaker: Mohit Saxena
segments.text: Ek idea hai paaji, hum apne khud ke truck khareed lein, transporter pe depend nahi rehna padega.

segments.speaker: Anjali Verma
segments.text: Khareedne ke liye kam se kam pachas lakh chahiye, aur maintenance alag.

segments.speaker: Harpreet Gill
segments.text: Nahi Mohit, apne truck khareedna abhi nahi. Woh idea chhodo, peak season mein ye risk nahi lenge.

segments.speaker: Mohit Saxena
segments.text: Theek hai paaji.

segments.speaker: Harpreet Gill
segments.text: Transporter ka rate dobara negotiate karna padega, diesel ke naam pe har mahine badha dete hain.

segments.speaker: Mohit Saxena
segments.text: Main transporter se baat karta hoon, saal bhar ka fixed rate maangunga.

segments.speaker: Harpreet Gill
segments.text: Mohit, month end tak naya rate final karke batao, January se naya contract chahiye.

segments.speaker: Mohit Saxena
segments.text: Haan, month end tak rate final kar dunga.

segments.speaker: Anjali Verma
segments.text: Yaad dila doon, trucks ka insurance renewal 20 December ko hai, woh bhi isi mahine.

segments.speaker: Harpreet Gill
segments.text: Haan insurance alag file hai, accounts dekh lega, rate wali baat se mat milao.

segments.speaker: Anjali Verma
segments.text: GPS trackers ki baat bhi thi. Chaar trucks mein abhi bhi tracker nahi hai.

segments.speaker: Mohit Saxena
segments.text: Isliye toh pata nahi chalta driver kahan ruka hai, do do ghante dhaba pe.

segments.speaker: Harpreet Gill
segments.text: Tracker lagwana zaroori hai. Koi bhi vendor ko bula ke lagwa de.

segments.speaker: Anjali Verma
segments.text: Main is hafte warehouse audit mein hoon, mujhse nahi hoga.

segments.speaker: Mohit Saxena
segments.text: Mere paas transporter ki meeting hai.

segments.speaker: Harpreet Gill
segments.text: Theek hai, koi kar lega, par parso tak chaaron trucks mein GPS lag jaana chahiye.

segments.speaker: Anjali Verma
segments.text: Return loads ka bhi socho, trucks Jaipur se khaali wapas aate hain.

segments.speaker: Mohit Saxena
segments.text: Wahan ek fabric supplier hai jo maal bhejta hai, unse return load ki baat kar sakte hain.

segments.speaker: Harpreet Gill
segments.text: Achha idea hai, par pehle naya route set ho jaye, phir dekhte hain.

segments.speaker: Anjali Verma
segments.text: Driver ke liye winter allowance ka bhi sawaal aaya tha.

segments.speaker: Harpreet Gill
segments.text: Woh main HR ke saath dekhunga, aaj decide nahi kar sakte.

segments.speaker: Mohit Saxena
segments.text: Toll tag ka recharge time pe nahi hota, do baar truck plaza pe atka.

segments.speaker: Anjali Verma
segments.text: Auto recharge laga dete hain account pe, ek baar ka kaam hai.

segments.speaker: Harpreet Gill
segments.text: Haan kar do. Aur kuch?

segments.speaker: Mohit Saxena
segments.text: Nahi paaji, bas rate wali meeting ke baad update dunga.

segments.speaker: Anjali Verma
segments.text: Mera bhi ho gaya.

segments.speaker: Harpreet Gill
segments.text: Theek hai, dhanyavaad dono ka. Safe driving sab ko bol dena.

decisions.fact: The Jaipur route runs one large truck instead of two small ones.
Night deliveries on the Ludhiana route stop while there is fog; daytime only.

action_items.fact: Mohit renegotiates a fixed yearly rate with the transporter.
GPS trackers are installed in the four remaining trucks; nobody named.
Anjali aligns both Jaipur vendors on a single 10 am pickup time.

distractors.fact: Buying the company's own trucks was suggested and dropped.
20 December is the truck insurance renewal, not the transporter rate's due date.
